title: The Maya, Aztec and Inca
examples: How did these civilizations organize their cities?
What was the purpose of the calendars they used?
Can you explain how the Inca built their roads?

explain.say: The Maya built large, complex cities in Mesoamerica.
The Aztecs established their city, Tenochtitlan, on a lake.

draw.text: Aztec City: Tenochtitlan on a lake

explain.say: The Inca created impressive roads connecting their empire.
The Maya developed sophisticated calendar systems for tracking time.
The Inca built the amazing citadel of Machu Picchu high in the mountains.
These civilizations relied on organized travel and planning.

items: Survey the land for best route

faq.q: What was the main purpose of the Maya calendar?
faq.a: The calendar helped them track religious festivals and important cycles. It was used for predicting times for rituals.
asks: How did they keep track of years?
Did they use the calendar for farming?

faq.q: Were the Inca roads paved with stone?
faq.a: Yes, the Inca were skilled engineers who built durable stone roads across difficult terrain. These roads connected their vast empire.
asks: How did they build across mountains?

faq.q: How big were the Aztec cities?
faq.a: The Aztec capital, Tenochtitlan, was a massive city built on an island in a lake. It was very large and complex.
asks: Did they live on land or water?
What was the main feature of their city?

faq.q: What makes Machu Picchu so famous?
faq.a: It is famous for its incredible location high in the Andes Mountains. The stone structures fit together perfectly without mortar.
asks: Is it difficult to get to?

faq.q: Did all three groups use the same writing system?
faq.a: No, each civilization developed its own unique methods of record keeping. The Maya are known for their writing.

facts: The Maya civilization flourished in Mesoamerica.
The Aztecs built their capital, Tenochtitlan, on a lake.
The Inca built an extensive road system throughout the Andes.
Machu Picchu is a remarkable Inca citadel in the mountains.

quiz.say: Which civilization is most associated with the citadel of Machu Picchu?
quiz.why: The Inca Empire is historically linked to the construction of Machu Picchu.

wrong.1: The Maya focused more on jungle cities than high mountain citadels.
wrong.2: The Aztecs were known for their lake-based city, Tenochtitlan.
wrong.3: The Romans were a different civilization located in Europe.

quiz.say: What was a key feature of the Aztec capital, Tenochtitlan?
quiz.why: The Aztecs ingeniously built their major city on an island in Lake Texcoco.

wrong.0: High mountains were the domain of the Inca people.
wrong.1: While rivers were important, their unique location was on a lake.
wrong.3: While the Maya lived in jungles, the Aztecs built on water.

quiz.say: If you needed to travel across a vast mountain range, which group's roads would you expect?
quiz.why: The Inca built famous, durable roads across the challenging mountain terrain.

wrong.0: The Maya's focus was more on jungle centers than massive mountain roads.
wrong.1: The Aztec network was primarily focused around their lake-based city.
wrong.2: The Egyptians were located in a completely different geographical area.
